question: A biopic on legendary Sitara Devi has been announced on her 101st birth anniversary by producer Raj C Anand. Sitara Devi was a recognized_______ dancer
solution:
The correct answer is **Kathak**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sitara Devi** was a renowned Kathak dancer.
 
• Born in **Kolkata in 1920, Sitara Devi** contributed significantly to the popularization of the Kathak form of Indian **classical dance.**
 
• Her mesmerizing performances earned her the moniker** "Nritya Samragini",** meaning the **Empress of Dance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi:**

 
 
• Odissi is a major ancient** Indian classical dance.**
 
• Odissi originated in the **Hindu temples of Odisha – an eastern coastal state of India. **
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:**
 
 
• Kathakali is a traditional dance form from Kerala, a state in South India.
 
• This dance form is a blend of **dance, music, acting, and drama**
 
• It is characterized by its elaborately **colorful makeup, costumes, and face masks. **
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi: **
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, a state of South India.
 
• It is named after the village in Krishna district where it developed.
